A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with readable main text, equations, Figures 1–12 and Appendices A–C. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support a complete, reliable comparison.

before.justification: Sections 3.1–3.2 and Appendix C report original teacher–student simulations and Fashion-MNIST/CIFAR10 experiments comparing learning protocols.

after.justification: v3 retains the original simulations and real-data experiments, including learning curves and replay-protocol comparisons in Section 3 and Appendix C.

M1.justification: The network architecture, SGD updates, optimal-control procedure and pseudo-optimal replay strategy are unchanged. The correction to Equation (25) concerns an intermediate derivation; the underlying update and operative ODEs remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same synthetic continual and multi-task scenarios, including three tasks in Appendix C.1, interpolated Fashion-MNIST tasks, and CIFAR10 tasks defined by label parity.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged, including no-replay/interleaved protocols, exponential and power-law schedules in Figure 9, and sequential/shuffled protocols in Figure 10.

E3.justification: Training budgets, model configurations, preprocessing, loss metrics and testing procedures are unchanged. Figure 2 retains N = 20,000, and Figure 7 retains the same downstream sample-size sweep from 500 to 8,000.

E4.justification: The replay-order randomization tests, task-similarity and training-budget analyses, and overlap/readout diagnostics in Figure 8 are unchanged. No ablation or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Figure 6 reports 100 realizations in both versions, while Figure 2 retains its single simulated trajectory. Uncertainty displays and statistical reporting are unchanged.

E6.justification: The empirical curves, reported numerical results and rankings in Figures 2–12 and their accompanying text are unchanged, including the CIFAR10 findings in Appendix C.2.

T1.justification: Appendix A.2, Equation (25), changes the quadratic-update prefactor from (eta^mu)^2 to (eta^mu)^2/N. This restores a missing normalization factor in the finite-step overlap increment, making it consistent with Equation (14) and the unchanged limiting Equations (26)–(27). The remaining derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about optimal task-selection and learning-rate schedules, task similarity, and transferring the pseudo-optimal strategy to real data.

C2.justification: The focus/revision interpretation, feature-versus-readout explanation, CIFAR10 qualifications and Section 4 limitations are unchanged, including the absence of guaranteed global optimality.

D1.justification: Architecture, initialization, data construction, SGD and control-solver details remain unchanged. No implementation settings or code/data access information are added or removed.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, novelty positioning and bibliography are unchanged. No cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: v3 removes the stray word 'performance.' after 'at a given training time' in Section 3.1 and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Other prose and document structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–12 retain their panels, curves, labels, captions and placement. Page organization is unchanged; the corrections produce only incidental local text and equation reflow.

improvement.justification: v3 repairs the missing 1/N in Appendix A.2, Equation (25), resolving an inconsistency between the discrete update and its continuum limit. Together with the small prose correction, this modestly improves mathematical correctness and readability. The method, empirical evidence, claims and limitations remain unchanged.
